description: Fingerprints of platforms whose primary workflow is AI-assisted site or app generation, and explicit AI-tool generator markers. A match identifies the platform (question A) and, through aiAssociation, produces a separate AI-related finding (question B) whose strength never exceeds the platform evidence.

signatures.name: Lovable (formerly GPT Engineer)

provenance.reference: Public Lovable-generated index.html files (e.g. on Hugging Face Spaces) contain <script src="https://cdn.gpteng.co/gptengineer.js" type="module"> with a 'DO NOT REMOVE' comment. lovable.app is Lovable's hosting domain.

signatures.description: Lovable projects historically include the gptengineer.js editor script and are published on *.lovable.app.

matchers.explanation: The Lovable / GPT Engineer editor script is referenced by the page.
The site is served from Lovable's hosting domain.
The site is served from Lovable's preview domain.

matchers.pattern: DO NOT REMOVE THIS SCRIPT TAG OR THIS VERY COMMENT
matchers.explanation: Comment that accompanies the GPT Engineer script in Lovable templates.

matchers.name: author
matchers.explanation: Default author meta value left from a Lovable template.
Default Open Graph image pointing to lovable.dev.

aiAssociation.rationale: Lovable is a platform where applications are primarily created by prompting an AI agent.
alternativeExplanations: The project may have been created in Lovable but substantially rewritten by hand.
Code written elsewhere can be imported into Lovable and published there.
The marker may remain in the HTML after the project left Lovable.

limitations: Markers are trivially removable; their absence says nothing.
falsePositiveConsiderations: Pages that merely link to or mention Lovable do not match: matchers inspect script sources, hostnames, comments and meta tags only.

signatures.name: v0 by Vercel

provenance.reference: Reported as default metadata in v0-generated Next.js layouts; not reproduced by a maintainer (a public v0 layout checked on 2026-10-29 did not contain it).

signatures.description: Some v0-generated Next.js projects keep a generator metadata value naming v0.

aiAssociation.rationale: v0 is an AI UI/app generator.
alternativeExplanations: A developer may have started from v0 output and rewritten it.
Anyone can set any generator value.

limitations: Signature not reproduced; strength capped at weak while experimental.

signatures.name: Base44
signatures.description: Base44 apps are reported to be published on *.base44.app.

matchers.explanation: The site is served from a domain reported as Base44's app hosting domain.

aiAssociation.rationale: Base44 is marketed as an AI app builder.

limitations: Signature not reproduced; strength capped at weak while experimental.

signatures.name: Replit
signatures.description: Replit deployments are served from *.replit.app (and legacy *.repl.co).

matchers.explanation: The site is served from Replit's deployment domain.

aiAssociation.rationale: Replit offers an AI agent for building apps, but it also hosts many hand-written projects.
alternativeExplanations: Most Replit-hosted code may be written manually; hosting alone is a weak indicator.

signatures.name: "Edit with Lovable" badge
signatures.description: Free-plan Lovable sites are reported to show an 'Edit with Lovable' badge element.

matchers.explanation: Element with the reported Lovable badge id.

aiAssociation.rationale: The badge would indicate a Lovable-published project.
alternativeExplanations: Any page can use this element id.

limitations: Selector not reproduced; capped at weak while experimental.
